monitor_plan.salt_admission: local read-only audit only; omit all SALT calls if no eligible non-Qwen local records are present

selection_algorithm: Reuse the already frozen 8 pilot and 40 main payoff contexts from Track 2.3 v1. Pilot has one recipient call per arm; main has 24 within-context blocks, with each of the 24 arm orders used once per context. All 24 within-context outputs estimate response variability and are not independent scenario samples.
